WITH store_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        d_year AS dyear,
        's' AS sale_type,
        SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
    GROUP BY store_sales.ss_customer_sk, date_dim.d_year
),
web_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        d_year AS dyear,
        'w' AS sale_type,
        SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
    GROUP BY web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk, date_dim.d_year
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
    c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
    c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
    c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address
FROM customer AS c
JOIN store_totals AS t_s_firstyear
    ON c.c_customer_sk = t_s_firstyear.customer_sk
    AND t_s_firstyear.dyear = 1998
    AND t_s_firstyear.sale_type = 's'
JOIN store_totals AS t_s_secyear
    ON c.c_customer_sk = t_s_secyear.customer_sk
    AND t_s_secyear.dyear = 1998 + 1
    AND t_s_secyear.sale_type = 's'
JOIN web_totals AS t_w_firstyear
    ON c.c_customer_sk = t_w_firstyear.customer_sk
    AND t_w_firstyear.dyear = 1998
    AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type = 'w'
JOIN web_totals AS t_w_secyear
    ON c.c_customer_sk = t_w_secyear.customer_sk
    AND t_w_secyear.dyear = 1998 + 1
    AND t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w'
WHERE
    t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0
    AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0
    AND CASE
        WHEN t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0
            THEN t_w_secyear.year_total / t_w_firstyear.year_total
        ELSE 0.0
    END
    >
    CASE
        WHEN t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0
            THEN t_s_secyear.year_total / t_s_firstyear.year_total
        ELSE 0.0
    END
ORDER BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.c_email_address
LIMIT 100
